title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: A plain-English start in artificial intelligence for school leavers. Learn what AI really is, how chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini work, how to write good prompts, and how to use AI tools safely and responsibly for study, work and freelance income.
outcomes: Explain what AI, machine learning and generative AI are in simple words
Write clear prompts that get useful answers from AI chatbots
Use AI tools to speed up writing, design and virtual assistant tasks
Spot hallucinations and bias, and check AI answers before using them
Protect your privacy and use AI honestly at school and at work
Choose a realistic next step towards an AI-related career
